source: Approved v14 Pump.fun trucker is the common hat base. User-supplied local PNG files are unchanged lettering references only.

fitting.method: Recolor approved v14/trucker.png at native dimensions, preserving source alpha and coordinates, then render with the unchanged drawTrucker placement, clips and side trims. Omit only Pump.fun branding. Extract white embroidery from each supplied reference and scale it uniformly into the front panel. No supplied hat geometry, fabric, button, rope or bill is composited.
fitting.preserved: Identical approved panel construction, bill, mesh, seams, source shading and placement across all truckers. The two red variants differ only in embroidery. Original Pump.fun rendering and all existing source assets remain unchanged. No generated replacement artwork is used.
